name: brush-chart
title: Brush Chart
description: A long series with an overview strip: drag the window or its handles and the chart above zooms to it.

perf.budget: Two Skia canvases. The visible part is rebuilt on the UI thread while dragging; the overview path is built once per size. Nothing runs at rest.

measurements.notes: Before the window stopped re-rendering React on every drag frame this was 32 ms median with 36% janky frames.

a11y.reducedMotion: Screen reader steps move the window at once instead of springing.
a11y.screenReader: The chart is an image that reads the visible range and its first and last values; the strip is an adjustable range.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole strip is the target, 52 pt tall; handles respond 22 pt either side.
